A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Spire paper and complete supplementary Sections A-D. All 39 pages were compared: pages 2-39 render identically, and page 1 differs visually only in the arXiv margin stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original slide-generation experiments, component ablations, and qualitative comparisons in Section 3, plus pairwise evaluation results in supplementary Section C.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experiments and results in Section 3 and supplementary Section C.

M1.justification: The structural-denoising method, planner and critic, training objectives, rewards, and iterative execution procedure are identical in Section 2 and supplementary Sections B and D.

E1.justification: Both versions use Zenodo10k for training and held-out testing and SlideBench for out-of-distribution evaluation. The slide-personalization task and represented test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain AutoPresent, PPTAgent, SD 3.5, PSP (o4-mini), and PSP (Base). Comparator membership also matches in the critic ablation and supplementary pairwise evaluation.

E3.justification: The 200-deck sampling, chronological 80/20 split, single-reference setting, model configurations, similarity metrics, and VLM-judge procedures are unchanged, including the supplementary order-swapped pairwise evaluation.

E4.justification: Both retain the same fine-tuning, iterative-revision, and critic ablations in Section 3.4, Tables 2-3, and Figure 4. Out-of-distribution tests and supplementary qualitative analyses are also identical.

E5.justification: Both report the same point estimates without experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are identical. For example, main Table 1 retains Spire's judge averages of 0.5415 on test pages and 0.7333 on OOD pages; supplementary Table 2 also matches exactly.

T1.justification: The PSP formulation, surrogate-approximation and variance-reduction statements, assumptions, and proofs are unchanged in Section 2 and supplementary Section A.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about inverse planning, structural denoising, two-agent variance reduction, and empirical effectiveness.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning preference-aligned training, generalization, baseline failures, and disagreement between similarity and judge metrics are identical. No applicability qualification or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Data-construction instructions, training hyperparameters, reward details, perturbation procedures, and prompt templates are unchanged throughout the supplement. No implementation or code/data access information changes.

R1.justification: The same 54 references and related-work discussion are retained. Positioning against template-based, instruction-driven, and existing personalized slide-generation approaches is unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv stamp changes from v1, 1 July 2026, to v2, 12 August 2026. PDF author metadata capitalizes 'jing Gao' as 'Jing Gao'; the printed author name, manuscript wording, and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Only the updated first-page arXiv margin stamp changes its placement and extent. All figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layout otherwise match, including the appendices.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, experiments, results, proofs, and reproducibility information are identical, including the appendices. Updating the arXiv stamp and correcting author-name capitalization in PDF metadata do not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
